entities.name: Illith
entities.description: A Demonic Tutor from Hell stranded on a plane of white, green and blue mana, who helps Helana rescue her father.

entities.name: Hell
entities.description: Home of Illith, ruled by archdukes.

entities.name: Koborah
entities.description: A Sun priest who bound Illith and was pushed through the Hellgate.

entities.name: Helana
entities.description: A girl with magical power who tracks down Illith and rescues her father.

entities.name: Gohrah
entities.description: Goddess, the dark side of the Moon, apparently guiding Helana.

entities.name: Archduke
entities.description: Ruler of that part of Hell, killed when his spell misfires.

events.summary: Illith is pulled into a duel between Gerheart and his enemy; Koborah binds him with holy magic.
events.quote: the Sun priest Koborah bound him with holy magic

events.summary: A Fireball pushes Koborah through the Hellgate, stranding Illith.
events.quote: leaving Illith stranded on the unnamed plane of white, green, and blue mana

events.summary: Helana and Rorsa track Illith down.
events.quote: he was tracked down by the girl Helana and her flying dog Rorsa

events.summary: Illith and Helana tricked the Archduke's servants into releasing her father; the Archduke's spell misfires and kills him.
events.quote: the Archduke's spell misfired, blasting his palace apart and killing him and most of his servants

relations.note: Helped her rescue her father and stays in touch.
relations.quote: He offered to rescue her father
the girl Helana and her flying dog Rorsa
